subset: ASCII 32-126, NBSP alias to space, other bytes question mark
italic: Synthetic oblique: shift each glyph row right by floor((9-row)/4) pixels, maximum 2; preserve advance. No additional font asset.

body_variant.source: Independent X.Org Adobe/DEC helvR08 BDF glyphs. Original ELKSWeb t/numeral hints. Existing advances retain helvR08/B08-derived dimensions. No reference-browser assets.
body_variant.transform: J trial: preserve established advances, bold, a/t/numeral hints and H small face. Replicate BDF source columns with balanced endpoint allocation for other regular glyphs. Extend isolated contiguous horizontal bars/round shoulders by one available pixel at each end, excluding diagonals and repeated vertical stems. No reference-browser font data.
body_variant.packing: 190 one-byte advances + 190 unsigned-short offsets +1936 bitmap bytes. Each eight-row glyph uses one byte per row for ink widths<=8, two otherwise. Shared by regular/small/mono rendering.
body_variant.original_hints_license: GPL-2.0-or-later; original BDF-derived portions retain font/COPYING.

small_variant.transform: Regular six-row face independently derived from helvR08 BDF, retaining body-derived advances. Preserve lowercase counter rows; capitals remove one duplicate interior row; original ELKSWeb six-row numeral and a hints. A separate j descender survives. Packed95offsets+588pixelbytes. Bold keeps the prior shared-body rendering. Italic remains clipped within each advance.

mono_variant.transform: Shared packed body glyphs centered/fitted in fixed cells: small8x6, regular9x8, large12x10; bold adds one to advance. One blank trailing column retained.
